## Контракт фазы

**Контракт фазы (contract-first).** Потребляет: terminal P1 и текущие detail/card DTOs ·
Производит: typed snapshot completeness, безопасный document removal/current-set reconcile и
честный B2 contract · Границы: storage writes/retries/timeouts остаются P3; live EIS traffic — только P4.1, P4.2 потребляет persisted evidence offline.

## Произведено

- P2.1 — Различить complete/incomplete/failed documents snapshot и защитить archive children: typed snapshot result, root-only reconcile, observable failure path, seven named regressions and lifecycle docs. Closure: failed/incomplete pages remove nothing; true complete shrink removes only missing platform roots once; unchanged parent preserves children; valid empty complete removes roots intentionally; commands green.
- P2.2 — Синхронизировать current items и parties только по complete common snapshot: complete common snapshot carrier, atomic current-set reconcile, shrink/empty/renumber/partial/rollback regressions and schema/lifecycle docs. Closure: complete snapshot exactly matches active items/parties; incomplete/failed changes none; rollback leaves pre-state whole; no duplicate organizations/pivots; commands green.
- P2.3 — Запечатать B2 как условный контракт с live-verification branch: `@plan/knowledge/findings-P2-b2-live-protocol.json`, corrected docs, current-behavior regression and explicit P4.1 A1/B2 artifact schemas. Closure: no documentation claims full automatic same-uid versioning; every D8 branch is executable and fail-closed; layer `artifacts → findings → research` is specified with digest links; app/config/migration/routes diff is empty; tests/grep/diff green.
